in_marathi.name: Bhupender
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhupender हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhupender is a Sanskrit name derived from Bhuh (Lord) and Pinda (Earth). This name signifies the one who rules over the earth. It is a revered name in Hindu culture and is often given to boys.
